notes.title: New Build - Story Mode Preview!
notes.content:
This is a big one! Here's a preview of our story mode!

General
Story Mode Preview! - Try out Vince's prequel and see an example of his story mode play style.
Slapping is an entirely valid dialogue response!
Removed poker from Story Preview
Options menu can now be opened and closed via Escape key.


Enjoy!!

notes.title: New Build - Notifications!
notes.content:
General
New Notification System added to display information in real time. 
Emotes bar is now hidden by default. Click the emotes button on the top left to toggle it on and off.


Notifications
At the start of a match, we now remind the players of the objective of the venue. (Most money of 7 hands, winner take all, etc).
Notify when you are hit with an ability. Green for buffs, red for being attacked.
Notify when it's your turn
Click on the notification to hide it
Any key press will advance to the next notification (or hide them if none).


AI
AI will use slightly fewer abilities.

notes.title: New Build - PAX South Enhancements
notes.content:
General
The end game stage will now space out characters a bit more to reduce clipping.
Emotes may now be used while waiting for upgrades to complete.


Character Changes

Improved Carmen's Dogfight level 1 ability to show a card's value instead of the suit.
Renamed Lucky's power Second Look to Double Take
Fixed Lucky's Double Take ability to correctly use the +1 / +2 range (they were reversed)
When using Lucky's Lucky card II ability on a card with the value of 2, it has a chance to become an Ace. Likewise, an Ace could become a 2.


UI

Read Faces now has a tooltip
Tooltips on status icons will show up with a red title for a debuff, and green for a buff.
Lucky's Lucky card ability will highlight the affected cards when the next round occurs, and a new card hits the river.


Enjoy! Much more on its way soon!

notes.title: New Build - Single Player Practice Mode Timers
notes.content:
We've slowed down Single Player Practice Mode by removing the turn timer pressures. Now you'll have the time to explore and learn your favorite characters and their abilities before taking them into multiplayer battles!

Single Player Practice ModeTurn timers are set to 7.5 minutes.
Turn Timers will no longer auto-check / call / fold

AI ThinkingThe AI will slow down a bit and plan their moves more carefully. 

Game On!
